title: Figure 43: "Spaceways Entering the 21st Century" space infrastructure illustration
description: Black-and-white line illustration of Earth with orbital paths linking labeled assets: "Navigation Weather," "Space Based Warning," "Space Based Tracking," "N-RLV," "deceased MIR," "Space Station," "GEO Satellites," "LEO-Lunar Routes ??" and "Planetary Exploration," with a covered wagon and oxen drawn at lower right. Captioned "Spaceways Entering the 21st century" and "From Dr. William Gaubatz"; document caption: "Figure 43. Where We Are Today."
